kpis.description_fr: CA services sans-fil (postpaid + prepaid + FWA + autres) : metrique cle telecom, 65% du CA total VZ FY25.
kpis.description_en: Wireless service revenue (postpaid + prepaid + FWA + other): key telecom metric, 65% of VZ FY25 total revenue.

kpis.description_fr: Average Revenue Per Account (postpaid) : levier monetisation premium, hausses tarifaires et up-sell perimeter cles offres.
kpis.description_en: Average Revenue Per Account (postpaid): premium monetization lever, tariff hikes and perimeter offer up-sell key.

kpis.description_fr: Connexions postpaid (incluant telephone + tablette + FWA + IoT) : base la plus monetisable, stabilite signe maturite marche US.
kpis.description_en: Postpaid connections (incl. phone + tablet + FWA + IoT): most monetizable base, stability reflects mature US market.

kpis.description_fr: Connexions FWA (5G/4G home internet) : pari strategique VZ vs cable + fibre, croissance forte 5G 35x base 2020.
kpis.description_en: FWA connections (5G/4G home internet): strategic VZ bet vs cable + fiber, strong 5G growth 35x 2020 base.

kpis.description_fr: Revenu Fios (fibre Consumer + Business) : actif premium, declin video compense par croissance internet, future synergies Frontier 2026.
kpis.description_en: Fios revenue (fiber Consumer + Business): premium asset, video decline offset by internet growth, Frontier 2026 synergies ahead.

kpis.description_fr: CA segment Consumer (wireless + Fios + autre) : 80% du CA groupe, sur lequel se joue la valeur actionnaire VZ.
kpis.description_en: Consumer segment revenue (wireless + Fios + other): 80% of group revenue, where VZ shareholder value plays out.

_notes: Reconstruit chunk-6 mission #20 : 5-6 ans 2020-2025 depuis 10-Ks Verizon. Telecom KPIs canoniques (Wireless Service Rev, ARPA, Postpaid Connect, FWA, Fios) = standard secteur telecom US.
